notes:
REF-BM-02: Save performs no remote metadata collection.
REF-BM-03: A title can be entered before saving, but description editing, collected metadata, and post-save editing are missing.
REF-BM-04: Existing bookmark fields cannot be edited.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are blocked, but the user is not guided into editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title and URL, but not description, tags, or favicon.
REF-BM-09: Bookmarks support only one static collection, not one or more tags.
REF-BM-10: No tag entry or autocomplete exists.
REF-BM-11: Collection filtering exists, but tag filtering does not.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and URL only, not description or note.
REF-BM-14: #tag search is unsupported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: Multi-selection supports collection assignment and deletion, but not tag removal, read state, or archiving.
REF-BM-21: No action applies automatically to every bookmark matching the current filter.
REF-BM-22: No list sorting controls or sort logic exist.
REF-BM-23: Notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Collections are static assignments, not reusable dynamic bundles of search and tag criteria.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are available.
